summary: New acceptance_matrix (8 criteria) for the German Datenschutzerklärung page, re-focused on controller identity without a home address, app-feature coverage, technical/storage transparency, marked open legal points, account-deletion description, the profile settings link, and combined iPhone/auth-link readability. The page (src/routes/datenschutz.tsx, src/components/LegalPage.tsx) already implements all of this; verified with 6 new browser checks against the public preview URL plus one code-based route check for the profile link (no test account exists, as noted in the briefing). All 7 artifacts passed; no bugs found.

checks.name: datenschutz-public-https-title
checks.evidence: Direct goto of https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com/datenschutz without auth returned status <400, privacy-page testid visible, document.title contains 'Datenschutz'.

checks.name: datenschutz-controller-no-address
checks.evidence: privacy-controller-details contains 'Nico Etterer', privacy-controller-email contains 'n.etterer@outlook.de', privacy-controller-address-note states no private home address is published; no placeholder address text found in page body.

checks.name: datenschutz-app-features-sections
checks.evidence: All 9 expected sections visible: privacy-account-section (Supabase Auth), privacy-profile-section (XP/Level/Abzeichen), privacy-spots-section (Fundorte/Fotos), privacy-community-section (Chat), privacy-direct-messages-section (DM/Freunde), privacy-crew-section (Crew Finder), privacy-arcade-section (Neon Arcade/Bestenlisten), privacy-push-section (Push), privacy-payments-section (Stripe).

checks.name: datenschutz-tech-services-storage
checks.evidence: privacy-provider-supabase/-emergent/-stripe/-push mention Supabase, Emergent, Stripe, APNs; privacy-cookies-text mentions sidebar_state cookie; privacy-technical-text states no recognizable analytics/ad SDKs in project code; privacy-technical-missing keeps server/infra logs marked BITTE PRÜFEN.

checks.name: datenschutz-unresolved-points-marked
checks.evidence: privacy-legal-bases-missing, privacy-rights-missing contain BITTE PRÜFEN; privacy-hosting-missing, privacy-retention-missing, privacy-transfer-missing contain BITTE ERGÄNZEN; no fabricated provider location/retention strings found in page text.

checks.name: datenschutz-account-deletion-description
checks.evidence: privacy-retention-account text references 'Konto löschen', 'delete_my_account', 'best-effort' file deletion and an Admin-account restriction; does not claim unrestricted deletion.

checks.name: profile-privacy-settings-link (code/route check)
checks.evidence: No test account exists (per briefing) so verified via source: src/routes/profil.tsx line 76 renders `<Link to="/datenschutz" data-testid="profile-privacy-settings-link" ...>Datenschutzerklärung</Link>` inside the profile settings/privacy block (after profile-privacy switches section).

checks.name: auth-form-privacy-link-iphone-readable
checks.evidence: At 390x844 on the public preview, auth-privacy-footer-link visible on login page; click navigates to /datenschutz (privacy-page visible, url contains /datenschutz); document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 confirming no horizontal scroll on the privacy page.
